events.title: New Quest UI added to "Contracts" Mode!
events.summary: Hey everyone!Thanks to popular demand from our community, we have added a brand-new Quest UI to the new "Contracts" mode! You can now easily track all your active objectives and assignments while in action.Thank you all for the great feedback – have fun blasting through your contracts!
